component.name: ProbeScene2
component.script:
sub init() m.seq = 0 m.step = 0 m.scenario = "init" m.mode = "none" m.armed = false
m.outlet = m.top.findNode("outlet") m.page = m.top.findNode("page") m.gridA = m.top.findNode("gridA") m.gridB = m.top.findNode("gridB") m.overhang = m.top.findNode("overhang") m.menuA = m.top.findNode("menuA") m.menuB = m.top.findNode("menuB")
m.outlet.observeField("focusedChild", "onOutletFocus") m.overhang.observeField("focusedChild", "onOverhangFocus")
p("init", "ready", fs())
m.stepTimer = m.top.findNode("stepTimer") m.stepTimer.observeField("fire", "onStepTimer") m.stepTimer.control = "start" end sub
' ---------------------------------------------------------------- trace helpers
sub p(scenario as string, point as string, detail = "" as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 num = "00" + str(m.seq).trim() print "PROBE2|" + Right(num, 3) + "|" + scenario + "|" + point + "|" + detail end sub
function b(value as boolean) as string if value then return "T" return "F" end function
function fcId(node as object) as string result = "<err>" try fc = node.focusedChild if fc = invalid result = "invalid" else id = fc.id if id = "" then id = "<noid>" result = id end if catch e result = "<err>" end try return result end function
function fs() as string return "gridA=" + b(m.gridA.hasFocus()) + " gridB=" + b(m.gridB.hasFocus()) + " menuA=" + b(m.menuA.hasFocus()) + " menuB=" + b(m.menuB.hasFocus()) + " outletInChain=" + b(m.outlet.isInFocusChain()) + " outletFC=" + fcId(m.outlet) + " pageFC=" + fcId(m.page) + " overhangFC=" + fcId(m.overhang) + " sceneFC=" + fcId(m.top) end function
function payload(event as object) as string result = "<err>" try data = event.getData() if data = invalid result = "invalid" else if type(data) = "roSGNode" id = data.id if id = "" then id = "<noid>" result = "node:" + id else result = "type:" + type(data) end if catch e result = "<err>" end try return result end function
' ---------------------------------------------------------------- observers
sub onOutletFocus(event as object) p(m.scenario, "OBS-outlet", "data=" + payload(event) + " " + fs()) if not m.armed then return
if m.mode = "N2" and m.outlet.isInFocusChain() m.armed = false p(m.scenario, "OBS-outlet-nested", "calling gridB.setFocus(true) [forward: inside the chain just committed]") m.gridB.setFocus(true) p(m.scenario, "OBS-outlet-nested-done", fs()) else if m.mode = "N3" and not m.outlet.isInFocusChain() m.armed = false p(m.scenario, "OBS-outlet-nested", "calling gridA.setFocus(true) [backwards: outside the chain just committed]") m.gridA.setFocus(true) p(m.scenario, "OBS-outlet-nested-done", fs()) end if end sub
sub onOverhangFocus(event as object) p(m.scenario, "OBS-overhang", "data=" + payload(event) + " " + fs()) if not m.armed then return
if m.mode = "N1" and m.overhang.isInFocusChain() m.armed = false p(m.scenario, "OBS-overhang-nested", "calling menuB.setFocus(true) [forward: sibling inside the chain just committed]") m.menuB.setFocus(true) p(m.scenario, "OBS-overhang-nested-done", fs()) end if end sub
' ---------------------------------------------------------------- scenario driver
sub onStepTimer() m.step = m.step + 1
if m.step = 1 m.scenario = "prep" m.gridA.setFocus(true) p(m.scenario, "after", fs())
' -------- N1: overhang gains focus; its observer forwards focus to menuB else if m.step = 2 m.scenario = "N1-forward-sibling" m.mode = "N1" m.armed = true p(m.scenario, "before", fs()) m.menuA.setFocus(true) p(m.scenario, "after", fs()) else if m.step = 3 m.scenario = "N1-forward-sibling" p(m.scenario, "settled", fs())
' -------- N2: outlet gains focus; its observer forwards focus to gridB else if m.step = 4 m.scenario = "N2-forward-deeper" m.mode = "N2" m.armed = true p(m.scenario, "before", fs()) m.gridA.setFocus(true) p(m.scenario, "after", fs()) else if m.step = 5 m.scenario = "N2-forward-deeper" p(m.scenario, "settled", fs())
' -------- N3: outlet loses focus; its observer grabs it back (the JellyRock steal) else if m.step = 6 m.scenario = "N3-prep" m.mode = "none" m.armed = false m.gridA.setFocus(true) p(m.scenario, "after", fs()) else if m.step = 7 m.scenario = "N3-backwards-steal" m.mode = "N3" m.armed = true p(m.scenario, "before", fs()) m.menuA.setFocus(true) p(m.scenario, "after", fs()) else if m.step = 8 m.scenario = "N3-backwards-steal" p(m.scenario, "settled", fs())
' -------- N4: does a settled state recover? plain focus move after the steal else if m.step = 9 m.scenario = "N4-recover" m.mode = "none" m.armed = false p(m.scenario, "before", fs()) m.gridB.setFocus(true) p(m.scenario, "after", fs()) else if m.step = 10 m.scenario = "N4-recover" p(m.scenario, "settled", fs()) m.stepTimer.control = "stop" print "PROBE2|---|done|MANUAL|Probe complete - press BACK to exit."
end if end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if press p(m.scenario, "SCENE-onKeyEvent", "key=" + key + " " + fs()) end if if key = "back" and press m.top.probeExit = true return true end if return false end function
